d: Yemen’s war is entering a dangerous new phase. Houthi forces have seized key territory along the Red Sea coast, putting pressure on Saudi Arabia and raising concerns over vital shipping and oil routes. An Italian Eurofighter was also reportedly damaged during an attack on a Saudi air base. As Riyadh seeks help from Oman, China and Egypt, Beijing is urging Iran to restrain the Houthis. But what do the Houthis want—and can territorial gains translate into political power? We decode the escalating conflict, the regional stakes and the battle for the strategic Bab el-Mandeb.
